remark: SecurityException can be triggered if there is a security manager installed (e.g., via the command line or policy file) that does not permit access to the system properties being read (e.g., 'os.name', 'java.io.tmpdir', etc.). Since the code runs without any permission check or privilege escalation, any of the `System.getProperty` calls could throw SecurityException in a restricted environment.
